criteria:
To earn the microcredential for this module, be sure your reflection includes:

Reading to Write: Say-Mean-Matter

Micro-Credential

Issuer
National Writing Project

Description

This microcredential recognizes your planning and preparation to use the Say-Mean-Matter framework and/or They Say / I Say with your students. By reflecting on how you will introduce the routine, creating a classroom-ready example, and identifying which strategy you’ll try out in Module 4, you’ll take the next step in helping students move from summary toward deeper analysis and significance.

Criteria

To earn the microcredential for this module, be sure your reflection includes:

  • A response describing how you might introduce Say-Mean-Matter to your students, including what you see as most helpful and what might be challenging.

  • An uploaded example you’ve created to try out with students. This could be a handout or chart, a text plus directions, or a sample notebook/annotation page that models either They Say / I Say or Say-Mean-Matter.

  • Your choice of which strategy from Modules 1–3 you are most interested in trying out with your students in Module 4.
